solutions.title: Four loops with dedupe set
solutions.strategy: Sort values, inspect every index quadruple, and insert matching value rows into a set.

timeComplexity.explanation: Four nested loops enumerate all index quadruples.

spaceComplexity.explanation: `a` unique answer rows are stored in the dedupe set and result list.

solutions.title: Sorted two-pointer sweep
solutions.strategy: Sort the array, fix two positions, then move a low/high pair while skipping duplicate values.

timeComplexity.explanation: Two fixed loops and one linear two-pointer sweep dominate.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Ignoring output, the sorted in-place array uses constant auxiliary space; answers store `a` rows.
